## Personality

Restless, chatty and allergic to blank spaces on maps. He paces when he thinks.

## Story

Gervase draws the kingdom's maps and surveyed the royal roads alongside the queen's consort when they were both young. He is making a new map of where monsters have been seen, and it is getting crowded.
